messages:
Aisha (CSM): FYI Lumenix renewal due next Wed. They asked to shorten to a 9‑month term to match their fiscal cadence. Procurement said PO LUM-2025 will come today.
Ben (AM): OK — did we confirm the 9mo pricing? any approval needed?
Aisha (CSM): Sales agreed to a one-time ~8% reduction for the 9mo. Legal needs to sign an addendum with prorate and no-auto-renew clause.
Daniel (Legal): I can approve. I'll draft a 9mo addendum with explicit prorate language and "no auto-renew". Will upload to DocuSign and review internal counsel.
Kira (Finance): Procurement prefers net30. I'll prepare invoice draft and hold until PO arrives. If PO lands, I’ll attach final invoice to the envelope.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope created and sent to procurement@lumenix.com — envelope ID: env_0b9f3a (sent).
Priya (Solutions): Lumenix requested training within two weeks of signature. We can run a condensed enablement workshop; need a firm date post-sign. Can also prepare a sanitized ROI dashboard sample.
Aisha (CSM): @Priya can you have the ROI mock and workshop agenda ready by EOD tomorrow?
Priya (Solutions): Yes — ROI mock (anonymized) + 2‑hour condensed agenda by EOD tomorrow.
Ben (AM): If signature stalls >48h, let's share pre-onboard docs and sample dashboard, but keep production access gated until payment clears. Keeps momentum.
Aisha (CSM): Agreed. Marking renewal tracker: status=waiting_on_signature, risk=medium, notes=9mo term approved pending signatures; invoice draft ready; onboarding requested within 2 weeks.
Daniel (Legal): If procurement redlines, ping me and I’ll respond quickly.
Kira (Finance): I'll post the invoice once PO LUM-2025 arrives.
Aisha (CSM): I'll follow up with procurement in 2 hours and update here. /cc @Ben (AM) @Daniel (Legal) @Kira (Finance)
